biggest_catch: The named 'Microsoft Student Partner' no longer exists under that name — its successor (Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors) is unpaid per Microsoft's own community, but Microsoft's separate, currently-live Copilot Student Ambassador program publishes concrete paid compensation (up to $1,500). Verified on the Copilot program terms.
catches: The route name 'Microsoft Student Partner' is the legacy name; the current Microsoft Learn Student Ambassadors program is volunteer/perks-oriented, with Microsoft's own community stating ambassadors are not paid.

A separate, currently-live Microsoft program — Copilot Student Ambassador — publishes concrete paid compensation on microsoft.com: 'compensation of up to $1,500 upon completion of the program if all responsibilities are met' plus possible 'additional cash bonuses'.
The 'up to $1,500' is contingent on completing all responsibilities; it is not a guaranteed flat payout.
This verification follows the concrete paid terms where they actually exist (Copilot Student Ambassador), not the unpaid MLSA successor — see notes.
